ExecProbe.description:
A Tier-1 execution probe: feed ``stdin`` to the compiled locus program and
require ``expect_substring`` in stdout for the claim to hold.
ExecProbe.title: ExecProbe

StaticClaim.description:
A Tier-2 static assertion about the locus, checked against tool facts.

Any subset may be given; the attempt verifies iff *all* provided sub-claims
hold. ``dead_paragraph`` routes to call-graph reachability (D6).
StaticClaim.title: StaticClaim

SubmittedCodeLocus.description:
Provider-authored locus before host-side semantic validation.

JSON-schema structured output cannot express the cross-field rule that
multi-program loci require ``is_interprocedural=True``. Keep the submitted
value intact here, then let ``DriftPrediction`` validate it during trusted
input binding. A violation therefore abstains only that hunt instead of
invalidating every row in the provider batch.
